name: Witch-Hazel Ash
lore: Witch-hazel burnt to grey ash in a hedge-witch's hearth.
modifier: While the potion's effect lasts, you can't be targeted by Divination spells or perceived through magical scrying sensors.

name: Phoenix Pinion Soot
lore: Soot from a phoenix's pyre, gathered before the rebirth.
modifier: When you drink it, you also lose 1 Exhaustion level, and the Charmed and Frightened conditions end on you.

name: Leviathan Ambergris
lore: Ambergris from a leviathan, hardened by centuries at sea.
modifier: The potion never spoils, and it can be split into two half-doses: each has half the dice, bonuses and duration (round down).

name: Pulverized Gorgon Scale
lore: A gorgon's iron scale, filed to dust.
modifier: For 1 minute, you have Resistance to Bludgeoning, Piercing and Slashing damage from nonmagical attacks, but your Speed decreases by 10 feet.

name: Powdered Alchemical Silver
lore: Silver ground finer than flour; it hangs in the air like smoke.
modifier: The potion becomes an inhalant: it is breathed as a vapour instead of being drunk (see Use).

name: Fulgurite Splinters
lore: Glass made where lightning struck sand.
modifier: When the potion's effect ends, it does so with a thunderclap: each creature within 10 feet of you makes a DC 13 Constitution saving throw or takes 2d6 Thunder damage and is pushed 10 feet away from you.

name: Quickling Dust
lore: Dust shaken from a quickling's boots. It won't stay in the jar.
modifier: For 1 minute after drinking, your Speed increases by 10 feet.

name: Rust-Monster Antennae
lore: Antennae from a rust monster. Keep them away from your buckles.
modifier: The vial dissolves 1 round after it's opened, so the potion must be used at once. For 1 minute after, your touch rusts small nonmagical metal objects (a key, a lock, a nail) to flakes.

name: Gray Ooze Residue
lore: What a gray ooze leaves on the flagstones.
modifier: While the potion's effect lasts (up to 1 hour), your skin turns slick and stinging: you have Advantage on checks and saving throws to avoid or escape the Grappled and Restrained conditions.

name: Void Salt
lore: Salt that crystallises around a tear in the world.
modifier: The duration of the potion's effect is doubled. For 24 hours, you cast no shadow.

name: Grave-Tallow Drippings
lore: Tallow from candles that burned beside a lich's sarcophagus.
modifier: While the potion's effect lasts, magic that detects creature types registers you as Undead, and Undead with an Intelligence of 3 or lower ignore you unless you harm them.

name: Ghoul Claw Scrapings
lore: Scraped from under a ghoul's nails. Gloves are advised.
modifier: Once within the next hour, when you're reduced to 0 Hit Points but not killed outright, you can make a DC 10 Constitution saving throw. On a success, you drop to 1 Hit Point instead.

name: Powdered Nihilium
modifier: Stabilizes the alchemical matrix: none of the reagents react with one another, whatever their properties.

name: Rime-Iron Filings
lore: Iron filings that never warm, even in a forge.
modifier: While the potion's effect lasts (up to 1 hour), you have a +2 bonus to Armor Class, but your Speed decreases by 10 feet.

name: Yeti Frost-Hair
lore: Hair from a yeti's coat, still glittering with frost.
modifier: The potion stays ice-cold: you can drink it as a Reaction when you take Fire damage, instead of as a Bonus Action.

name: Dream-Amber Resin
lore: Resin that holds a dream the way amber holds a fly.
modifier: The potion lies dormant once drunk. If you're reduced to 0 Hit Points within the next 24 hours, it takes effect at that moment; otherwise it is wasted.

name: Displacer Beast Whisker
lore: A whisker from a displacer beast, which is never quite where it seems to be.
modifier: For 1 minute, attack rolls against you have Disadvantage. This benefit ends early if you're hit by an attack.

name: Cinder-Wraith Dust
lore: Dust swept up where a fire spirit was banished.
modifier: The effect begins 1d4 rounds after you drink it, with a burst of sparks: each creature within 5 feet of you makes a DC 12 Constitution saving throw or has the Blinded condition until the end of its next turn.

name: Efreeti Ember-Glass
lore: Glass blown from sand an efreeti once walked across.
modifier: For 1 minute, you have Resistance to Fire damage, and a creature that hits you with a melee attack takes 1d6 Fire damage.

name: Fire Beetle Gland Paste
lore: The glowing glands of a fire beetle, which shine for days after.
modifier: While the potion's effect lasts, you shed Dim Light in a 10-foot radius.

name: Mandrake Root-Hair
lore: Root-hairs combed from a mandrake while it sleeps.
modifier: When you drink it, you also gain 1d4 + 1 Temporary Hit Points.

name: Moonlit Mistletoe
lore: Mistletoe cut with a golden sickle under a full moon.
modifier: When the potion's effect ends, you regain 2d4 Hit Points.

name: Powdered Moonstone
lore: Moonstone ground under starlight, said to steady a wandering mind.
modifier: While the potion's effect lasts (up to 1 hour), you have Advantage on Constitution saving throws to maintain Concentration.

name: Rune-Etched Bone Chips
lore: Knucklebones carved with warding runes, then broken on purpose.
modifier: For 1 minute after drinking, you have Advantage on saving throws against spells.
